(async()=>{const C=await import('/js/flight/controls.js'); const out=[]; C.CTL.panels.pd.traverse(o=>{ if(o.isMesh && o.material.map){ const im=o.material.map.image; const g=im.getContext && im.getContext('2d'); let a=0; if(g){const d=g.getImageData(0,0,im.width,im.height).data; for(let i=3;i<d.length;i+=4) a+=d[i]>0?1:0;} out.push([o.geometry.parameters.width&&+o.geometry.parameters.width.toFixed(3), im.width, im.height, a, o.visible, o.material.opacity, o.position.z]); }}); return JSON.stringify(out.slice(0,8))})()
